name: OptCD
stack: Python; Bash; GitHub Actions; Maven; Gemini API
summary: A tool that finds directories a Maven build generates during a GitHub Actions run but never uses, traces each one to the plugin and workflow step responsible, and pushes a modified workflow that stops generating it. Presented at the ICSE 2025 Demonstrations Track; the underlying study appeared at ASE 2023.
bullets: Instruments a GitHub Actions workflow to find directories generated but never accessed, traces each to the responsible Maven plugin and step, and uses an LLM (Gemini) to propose a fixed workflow that it pushes for validation in CI|Built the evaluation pipeline: mined Java repositories through the GitHub API, filtered for Maven and GitHub Actions projects, and aggregated file-access logs from 600+ CI job runs into per-job and per-project results|Findings led to 25 pull requests to open-source projects that disable unnecessary generation

name: Gas Station Management System
summary: A desktop point-of-sale and accounting system for a fuel station: instant and credit billing, credit-company accounts and payments, fuel stock and tank refills, daily closing reports, profit and loss, and receipt printing.
bullets: Desktop point-of-sale and accounting app for a fuel station built with JavaFX and an embedded Apache Derby database|Covers instant and credit billing, credit-company accounts, fuel stock and tank refills, daily closing reports, and receipt printing

name: Chamena Griha
stack: PHP; MySQL; JavaScript; Nightwatch.js; Cucumber; Selenium; Docker; Travis CI
summary: A food-ordering and payment web app for college canteens that removes the queue: students order from the menu, canteen staff serve and track orders, and college admins manage students. Later covered with BDD acceptance tests that run in CI.
bullets: Food-ordering web app for college canteens with separate student, canteen, and college-admin roles|Added Gherkin acceptance tests (Nightwatch.js + Cucumber) and a Travis CI pipeline that provisions MySQL, seeds the schema, and runs Selenium in Docker

name: Fish Hunt
summary: A multiplayer Android game built with Unity: each player is a fish that eats food and smaller fish to grow, and the biggest fish when time runs out wins. Players host or join games over the local network or through Unity's relay.
